text: Three meeting dates are proposed for 2019 beyond the scheduled February 22, 2019 meeting. The date in April would be Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Annual General Meeting.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the following 2019 Board meeting dates: Tuesday, April 30, 2019 - 3:00 pm Thursday, July 11, 2019 - 9:00 am Friday, November 8, 2019 - 9:00 am
